about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: GetaddrService.java line 94: the guard of the private store(String) helper, which has no caller in GetaddrService.java: the program issues no file control command and the case has datasets {}, so no input runs it

GetaddrService.java line 206: the mutant tests calen != 0 instead of calen == 0 in front of `task.linkArea() != null`; the guard's second operand task.linkArea() returns null for every task of this estate: no program in the corpus names COMMAREA, CSSTATUS issues LINK GETPOL and LINK GETSPND with no COMMAREA clause and the rest start by RUN TRANSID, so the && is false and calen is left as it was; the one side effect of the call, linkAreaTaken = true, is read only by linkAreaBack and lastLinkBytes, which need a LINK that passed an area

GetaddrService.java line 206: the mutant compares calen with 1 instead of 0 in front of `task.linkArea() != null`; the guard's second operand task.linkArea() returns null for every task of this estate: no program in the corpus names COMMAREA, CSSTATUS issues LINK GETPOL and LINK GETSPND with no COMMAREA clause and the rest start by RUN TRANSID, so the && is false and calen is left as it was; the one side effect of the call, linkAreaTaken = true, is read only by linkAreaBack and lastLinkBytes, which need a LINK that passed an area

GetaddrService.java line 207: the assignment sits under `calen == 0 && task.linkArea() != null`, and task.linkArea() is null for every task of this estate (no program in the corpus names COMMAREA; CSSTATUS's LINK GETPOL / LINK GETSPND carry none; the other tasks start by RUN TRANSID), so the deleted statement never runs and EIBCALEN, its only target, is read by no program of the estate
